The House

We built the room around one idea: a meal should feel like sitting under a garden, not a ceiling.

Blush cherry blossoms spill over the front desk, rose-covered canopies float above the booths, and warm brass light pools onto leather seating below. It's a small, deliberate world — designed to slow you down before the first course even arrives.
